test_cases.test_case: Successful login with valid credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
User has valid credentials
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard page

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with invalid credentials
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Error message displayed indicating invalid credentials

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with empty username and password
preconditions: User is on the login page
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation messages for empty fields are displayed

test_cases.test_case: Login attempt with maximum length username and password
preconditions: User is on the login page
steps: 2. Enter username with maximum allowed length
3. Enter password with maximum allowed length
test_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to the Dashboard page

test_cases.test_case: Access Home page after successful login
preconditions: User is logged in
test_cases.expected_result: Welcome card with message 'Welcome, mifos!' is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Search activity on Dashboard
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
steps: 1. Enter search term in 'Search Activity' field
test_cases.expected_result: Relevant activity results are displayed

test_cases.test_case: Search activity with no results
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
steps: 1. Enter a non-existent search term in 'Search Activity' field
test_cases.expected_result: Message 'No results found' is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Search activity with special characters
preconditions: User is on the Dashboard page
steps: 1. Enter special characters in 'Search Activity' field
test_cases.expected_result: System handles input gracefully and displays relevant results or no results found

test_cases.test_case: Create a new client successfully
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on the Clients page
steps: 2. Fill in all required fields in the multi-step wizard
test_cases.expected_result: New client is created and displayed in the clients list with status 'Pending'

test_cases.test_case: Create a new client with missing required fields
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on the Clients page
test_cases.expected_result: Inline validation messages for missing required fields are displayed

test_cases.test_case: Create a new client with maximum length fields
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on the Clients page
steps: 2. Fill in all fields with maximum allowed length
test_cases.expected_result: New client is created successfully and displayed in the clients list

test_cases.test_case: View client details from the client list
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on the Clients page
steps: 1. Click on a client's name in the list
test_cases.expected_result: Client detail page is displayed with all relevant information

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to view client details for a non-existent client
preconditions: User is logged in
steps: 1. Manually enter a non-existent client ID in the URL
test_cases.expected_result: Error message indicating client not found is displayed

test_cases.test_case: Activate a pending client
preconditions: User is logged in
User is on the Client Detail page of a pending client
test_cases.expected_result: Client status changes to 'Active'

test_cases.test_case: Attempt to activate a client without an activation date
preconditions: User is logged in

test_cases.test_case: Activate a client with an activation date before submission date
preconditions: User is logged in

steps: 2. Enter an activation date before submission date
test_cases.expected_result: Error message indicating activation date cannot be before submission date is displayed
